title: 若手官僚「もう4時間怒鳴られずに済む」　国交省、電話応対を全面外注
extracted_text:
若手官僚の早期退職に歯止めをかける一手となるか。国土交通省は4月、国民からの苦情や問い合わせへの電話応対について、本省でコールセンターへの全面委託を始めた。

代表番号にかかってきた電話は、まず音声による自動応答システムが対応する。相手が担当課などの内線番号を把握していなければ電話交換手につながり、クレームや簡単な問い合わせの場合は外部のコールセンターに回す。

担当部署がつくった想定問答をもとに回答する。コールセンターで答えきれない場合は、担当者にメールで確認してから折り返す。重要な案件や専門的な問い合わせに限って、官僚が直接対応する。

2023年9月に住宅局や航空局など暮らしやビジネスと密接に関わり、問い合わせが多い部局から導入した。1カ月後のアンケートで住宅局の96%が「今後も続けてほしい」と答えたことなどを受け、段階的に拡大してきた。

コールセンターが職員の代わりに応対した時間は、25年6月の1カ月間の実績をもとに単純計算すると年1万6632時間にのぼる。これまで主に電話をとるのは若手職員で、ほかの業務に支障が出るだけでなく昼休みがつぶれるケースもあった。

「4時間怒鳴られ続けるような精神的負担がなくなった」。係長級の職員はこう話す。より年長の課長・室長級の職員からも「これまで電話対応に費やしていた時間をほかの業務に振り向けられ、生産性の向上につなげられる」との声が上がる。

コールセンターへの委託を担った担当者は「政策立案という本来の業務に専念できる体制をつくりたい」と話す。

国交省では「過労死ライン」と呼ばれる残業月80時間超の深刻な長時間労働が本省を中心に根強く残る。国会対応による深夜に及ぶ拘束だけでなく、電話応対などの雑務も重荷となり、若手のモチベーション低下や離職を招いていた。

人事院によると、キャリア官僚と呼ばれる総合職で採用から10年未満で辞めた人は24年度に174人と10年前の2.6倍に増えた。若手の離職防止は霞が関全体の課題だ。

厚生労働省は先んじて10年度にコールセンターを全面導入した。07年の「消えた年金記録問題」という不祥事で殺到した電話をさばききれなくなったからだ。国交省の取り組みが奏功すれば、若手の負担軽減策としての導入が広がるかもしれない。

【関連記事】
translated_text:
Could this help stem the tide of early retirements among young bureaucrats? In April, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT) began fully outsourcing phone handling for citizen complaints and inquiries to a call center based at the ministry headquarters.

Calls to the main representative number are first answered by an automated voice response system. If the caller does not know the direct extension number for the relevant department, they are transferred to a telephone operator, and for complaints or simple inquiries, the call is routed to an external call center.

The call center answers based on prepared Q&A sets created by each department. When the call center cannot provide an answer, they check with the responsible official by email and call back. Only important cases or specialized inquiries are handled directly by the bureaucrats.

The system was introduced in September 2023 starting with departments closely tied to daily life and business that receive high volumes of inquiries, such as the Housing Bureau and Aviation Bureau. Based on a survey conducted one month later, where 96% of Housing Bureau staff responded that they want the service to continue, the program was gradually expanded.

The time that the call center handled instead of staff amounts to an estimated 16,632 hours per year, calculated simply based on actual results for one month in June 2025. Previously, handling phone calls was mainly done by younger staff, which not only interfered with other work but sometimes also ate into lunch breaks.

"The mental burden of being yelled at for four hours straight is gone." This is how a section chief-level official described it. Even from more senior directors and division heads, there are voices saying, "The time previously spent on phone handling can now be directed to other work, leading to improved productivity."

The official in charge of the call center outsourcing said, "We want to create a system that allows officials to focus on their original work of policy formulation."

At MLIT, serious long-term overwork averaging over 80 hours of overtime per month—a level often called the "overwork death line"—remains deeply rooted, especially at the ministry headquarters. In addition to late-night sessions handling Diet affairs, tasks such as phone handling and other administrative work have been a heavy burden, contributing to demotivation and turnover among younger staff.

According to the National Personnel Authority, 174 career bureaucrats—those in specialist positions—left their jobs within 10 years of being hired in fiscal 2024, which is 2.6 times the number from 10 years ago. Preventing young staff turnover is an issue across all of Kasumigaseki.

The Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare had already fully introduced a call center system in fiscal 2010. This was because they were overwhelmed by a surge in calls following the 2007 "missing pension records scandal." If MLIT's initiative proves successful, its adoption as a way to reduce the burden on younger staff may spread elsewhere.
title_en: Young Bureaucrats Can Now Go 4 Hours Without Being Yelled At — Ministry of Land Fully Outsources Phone Handling
